# CPUBone

**Category:** Efficient/Mobile · **Code:**
[`timm/models/cpubone.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/cpubone.py) ·
**Architectures:** 9 · **Pretrained weights:** 9 (0 with ImageNet-1k results)

CPUBone is a vision backbone designed for devices with low parallelization capabilities, such as CPUs, built from
(fused) MBConv blocks and convolutional attention blocks.

## Papers

* [CPUBone: Efficient Vision Backbone Design for Devices with Low Parallelization
  Capabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.26425)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('cpubone_b0_bfrobust.r224_in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

✓ supported, ✓ (square) works for square sizes only, ✗ not supported, – not needed (the model already accepts any input
size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`CPUBone` with `cpubone_nano` at 224), other
architectures of the same class are expected to behave the same. See the [Model API](../model_api) page for details.
